svg.title: Uniform circular motion and its projection
svg.desc: A point P moves counterclockwise around a circle of radius X with constant angular velocity ω. The radius to P makes angle θ with the x axis. Its projection onto the x axis is at x, and the vertical distance from P to the axis is √(X² − x²). The velocity of P, of magnitude v_max, is tangent to the circle, and its x component is v: the velocity triangle is similar to the displacement triangle. As P goes around, its projection on the x axis moves back and forth in simple harmonic motion.
